question: If 7 cot P = 24, then find sin P.
solution:
**Given:**

7 cot P = 24

**Formula used:**

In Right-angle triangle

cotθ = {Baseover Perpendicular}

sinθ = {Perpendicularover Hypotenuse}

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa31fdbe33b2f97c71685ad9a92df65dcb48fe2cbc609f51546bf24933ef5aed.png] 

In Δ ABC

⇒ By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ AB2 = 242 + 7²

⇒ AB2 = 576 + 49 = 625

⇒ AB = √625 = 25

Now, sin P = {7over25}

**∴ The required result will be {7over25}.**
